Name: Advanced Cooking
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
[i]Update to 1.6 thanks to mouahrara[/i]

[b]Features[/size][/b]

This mod adds advanced functionality to the cooking interface, offering the following new, fully customizable features:

[list]
[*]Select which ingredients to use in cooking
[*]Cook multiple dishes at once
[*]Cook multiple of the same dish at once
[*]Cook dishes you haven't learned yet
[*]Get notice of which dishes your currently selected ingredients will cook
[*]Access all fridge inventories directly from the cooking interface
[*]Receive trash if you fail to cook anything useful
[/list]

[b][size=5]Usage[/size][/b]

Access the cooking interface in the upgraded farmhouse's kitchen as usual.

You can change which fridge (or player inventory) to take ingredients from using the arrow buttons in the interface.

As you add ingredients, the interface will (by default) tell you if you will successfully cook a dish and (by default) show which products you will cook when hovering over the OK button.

To cook the first available dish, click on the OK button.

To cook all available dishes at once, hold down the modifier key (default: [b]Left Shift[/b]) when clicking the OK button.

[youtube]kVAx-q8uJyw[/youtube]


[b][size=5]Configuration[/size][/b]

The following config variables are available in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM [/url]interface or by editing the mod's [b]config.json[/b] file after running the game once:

[list]
[*][b]CookAllModKey[/b]: default [b]LeftShift[/b] - hold down this key to cook everything possible with the current ingredients
[*][b]StoreOtherHeldItemOnCook[/b]: default [b]true[/b] - try to store a held item when cooking a different item (else cancel cooking)
[*][b]ConsumeIngredientsOnFail[/b]: default [b]false[/b] - lose all ingredients on an unsuccessful cook (doesn't happen if mod key is down)
[*][b]GiveTrashOnFail[/b]: default [b]true[/b] - a failed cook will produce trash instead
[*][b]ConsumeExtraIngredientsOnSucceed[/b]: default [b]true[/b] - lose all ingredients on a successful cook (doesn't happen if mod key is down)
[*][b]AllowUnknownRecipes[/b]: default [b]true[/b] - let you cook dishes you haven't learned yet
[*][b]LearnUnknownRecipes[/b]: default [b]true[/b] - learn recipes for dishes you cook but haven't learned yet
[*][b]ShowCookTooltip[/b]: default [b]true[/b] - show the "Cook" text when hovering over the OK button
[*][b]ShowProductsInTooltip[/b]: default [b]true[/b] - show what products can be cooked when hovering over the OK button (only shows multiple when mod key is down)
[*][b]ShowProductInfo[/b]: default [b]true[/b] - display number of items that can be cooked above the current ingredient list
[*][b]MaxTypesInTooltip[/b]: default [b]3[/b] - max number of named products to show in the tooltip (to save space, the rest will be grouped in a single additional entry)
[/list]


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.
